newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe police hunt Mugabe gold pen thief.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe police hunt Mugabe gold pen thief.

text.p: Zimbabwean police said on Friday they were searching for the person who stole a gold pen and two suits from President Robert Mugabe.

"We are still investigating and looking for the thief or thieves," a police spokesman said of local press reports that police had searched the homes of State House employees and recovered goods, including three shirts and cutlery.
"Those whose homes were searched are among the suspects, but the president is still missing his gold pen and two suits," the police spokesman said.
